conditions: Synthetic shared snapshot, same libqihse and compiler; current RSS after one context query, concurrent host workloads, page cache not dropped
measurement_order: All RSS pairs use the same immutable snapshot; refresh and authorization checks follow.
validation_scope: CLI and codec sources compiled with -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -O1; shared libqihse not instrumented; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1; UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1
memory_comparison: Do not compare sanitizer-process RSS with the normal baseline. Use codegraph_readonly_reference.json for performance measurements.
